subject: Storify — ops compatibility & architecture alignment session
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Cora Liang <cora.liang@storify.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Storify — ops compatibility & architecture alignment session

Hi Cora —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier this week. Based on what we discussed (inference latency targets, multi-tenant isolation, and audit/log retention needs), I think a short technical alignment session with our infra and ops leads will be valuable to validate topology and dataflows before we scope the POC.

Proposed scope (30–45m):
- Quick recap of Storify workload profile and SLOs (you)
- Redwood serving topology options (multi-tenant vs dedicated)
- Network & VPC considerations, egress controls
- Observability/runbook handoff and expected artifacts
- Open questions and next steps

Time options (Pacific times):
- Tue Mar 9, 09:30–10:15 PT
- Tue Mar 9, 13:00–13:45 PT
- Wed Mar 10, 08:00–08:45 PT (earlier slot)

If none of those work, please propose 2 slots that fit your calendar. I’ve attached a one-page agenda draft (proposed_arch_agenda.pdf).

CCing Ben (solutions eng) and Lauren (pre-sales PM) — Ben, could you join to cover runtime tradeoffs? Lauren, we may want to capture any procurement/commit expectations.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
[Attachment: proposed_arch_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Cora Liang <cora.liang@storify.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Storify — ops compatibility & architecture alignment session

Hi Mateo —

Thanks — that agenda looks good. Quick notes: our infra lead (Evan Park) will need to be on the call for the network/VPC section, and our security engineer wants to briefly confirm what audit logs are available and retention options.

The afternoon Tue slot at 13:00 PT would be tight for Evan. Can you do any of these instead?
- Tue Mar 9, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Wed Mar 10, 10:00–10:45 PT

If you can’t do those, we can move to Thu. Also, could you include a short runbook/run-of-show in the agenda so our SRE team can see handoff expectations?

Cc: Evan Park (evan.park@storify.com)

—Cora
Cora Liang
Head of Product Operations, Storify
cora.liang@storify.com

Thanks Cora — Tuesday 11:00 PT works for me. Mateo — we can do Tue Mar 9, 11:00–11:45 PT to accommodate Evan.

Great — thanks for the quick responses. Tue Mar 9, 11:00–11:45 PT is confirmed on our side. I’ve booked the slot and added a short runbook section to the agenda (final_agenda_v2.pdf) — see attached.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=storify-alignment-20270309
(If your calendar blocks, please accept the invite and I’ll re-check timezones.)

Agenda highlights:
- 5m intro & goals (Cora)
- 10m workload and SLOs (Cora + Evan)
- 15m Redwood serving topology & tradeoffs (Ben)
- 10m network/VPC and logging (Mateo)
- 5m next steps and owners

Attachments: final_agenda_v2.pdf, storify_alignment_invite.ics

If you want us to run any live demos, say so and we’ll carve 10–15m for a short run. Otherwise we’ll keep to the alignment topics above.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Mateo
